acceptanceCriteria: Each Work Item receives an independent identity-bound evidence receipt
No Work Item can reference another Work Item receipt as authorization evidence
Forged cost observation identity or counters is rejected or downgraded to unknown
Shared physical execution can be reused without sharing authority or decisions
goal: Ensure cross-Work-Item physical execution sharing never shares authority or authorization evidence, and cost observations are validated fail-closed.
intent: Bind shared physical verification facts to independent Work Item evidence receipts and reject forged cost telemetry.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: cross-work-item physical execution and tamper rejection
scenarioCoverage.expected: Shared execution yields independent Work Item receipts and forged cost telemetry is not trusted.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the physical execution, cost observation, and repository lifecycle regression tests.
